title: John R. Bassler, DrPH, MS
text:
About
As an experienced statistician, I’ve honed my skills in higher education, contributing to research and analytical initiatives. I seek to apply advanced spatial and survival statistical methods to public health challenges, with a focus on HIV and Oncology outcomes across Alabama and the Deep South.
I currently serve as Clinical Database Manager II in UAB’s Center for AIDS Research (CFAR), and I am completing my Doctor of Public Health (DrPH) in Biostatistics at UAB (defended: July 2026, expected graduation: December 2026), with a dissertation on shared frailty models for spatial data applied to time to HIV viral suppression. My work sits at the intersection of tiume-to-event analysis, spatial and Bayesian statistical methods, and structural determinants of health outcomes — including a study on historical redlining and delays in HIV treatment.
